name: ResourceQuotas
description: Unity Catalog enforces resource quotas on all securable objects, which limits the number of resources that can be created. Quotas are expressed in terms of a resource type and a parent (for example, tables per metastore or schemas per catalog). The resource quota APIs enable you to monitor your current usage and limits. For more information on resource quotas see the [Unity Catalog documentation](https://docs.databricks.com/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/index.html#resource-quotas).

methods.name: GetQuota
methods.description:
The GetQuota API returns usage information for a single resource quota, defined as a
child-parent pair. This API also refreshes the quota count if it is out of date.
Refreshes are triggered asynchronously. The updated count might not be returned in the first call.
methods.summary: Get information for a single resource quota.

required_fields.name: parent_securable_type
required_fields.description: Securable type of the quota parent.

required_fields.name: parent_full_name
required_fields.description: Full name of the parent resource. Provide the metastore ID if the parent is a metastore.

required_fields.name: quota_name
required_fields.description: Name of the quota. Follows the pattern of the quota type, with "-quota" added as a suffix.

methods.name: ListQuotas
methods.description:
ListQuotas returns all quota values under the metastore. There are no SLAs on the freshness of the counts
returned. This API does not trigger a refresh of quota counts.

PAGINATION BEHAVIOR: The API is by default paginated, a page may contain zero results while still providing a next_page_token.
Clients must continue reading pages until next_page_token is absent, which is the only indication that the end of results has been reached.
methods.summary: List all resource quotas under a metastore.

all_fields.name: max_results
all_fields.description: The number of quotas to return.

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description: Opaque token for the next page of results.

poll_field.description: Opaque token for the next page of results.
